name: PercentRankNode
label: Percent Rank
description: Adds a column with the relative rank (0 to 1) of each row within a partition, based on an ordering column.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table to compute percent rank for.

fields.name: OrderByColumn
fields.label: Order By Column
fields.description: The column used to determine the ordering.

fields.name: Ascending
fields.label: Ascending
fields.description: True to order in ascending order, false for descending. Defaults to true.

fields.name: PartitionByColumns
fields.label: Partition By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns that define partitions. Percent rank restarts per partition.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the percent rank column. Defaults to 'PercentRank'.
